choices.why: Low, wide Japandi sofa with a dark wood frame that suits the serene look and the dark floor, though it is medium grey rather than the beige the user asked for.
Natural sisal-look rug in warm tan with a bound edge, calm and Japandi.
Large round low wood table with a thin top, refined and minimal.
Tall rice paper lantern floor lamp, exactly the Japandi lantern requested.
Tall areca palm brings soft lush greenery to the bright corner by the glass door; it comes in a plastic nursery pot, so it does not meet the ceramic pot the user asked for.

answer.why: Warm tan fiber, walnut wood and an off-white paper lantern keep the room sparse and neutral, as the user wanted. Two parts of the request are not fully met: the sofa is grey instead of beige, and the palm comes in a plastic nursery pot instead of a ceramic one.
